<!doctype html>
<html lang="et">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow,noarchive">
<title>TEGUSÕNAD — PRAEGU</title>
<style>
:root {
  --blue:#123d8a;
  --blue2:#2b71d4;
  --blue3:#3c8cec;
  --green:#23b35d;
  --greenbg:#ebfaef;
  --red:#e15959;
  --redbg:#fff1f1;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#fff;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--blue)}
body{min-height:100dvh;display:flex;justify-content:center;overflow-x:hidden}
.app{width:min(100%,430px);min-height:100dvh;padding:6px 12px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#game{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:calc(100dvh - 16px)}
.header{flex:0 0 auto;position:relative}
.tools{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;display:flex;gap:5px}
.toolbtn{width:34px;height:34px;border:1.5px solid #d8e6f8;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--blue);font-size:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
.toolbtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a9cdf6;outline-offset:2px}
h1{margin:0;text-align:center;color:var(--blue);font-size:clamp(31px,8.2vw,40px);line-height:1;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.015em}
.subtitle{text-align:center;color:var(--blue2);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(18px,4.8vw,22px);margin-top:2px}
.score{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:2px;font-size:15px;font-weight:900}
.stars{display:flex;gap:1px}
.star{font-size:25px;line-height:1;color:#fff;-webkit-text-stroke:1.6px var(--blue)}
.star.filled{color:#ffc530;-webkit-text-stroke:1.8px #e69908}
.pills{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:7px;margin:4px 0 6px;flex:0 0 auto}
.pill{height:44px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.01em}
.person-pill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#eef4ff,#dce8ff)}
.time-pill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff4cf,#ffe9a5)}
.icon-ball{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;background:#fff8}
.verb{align-self:center;background:#dcebff;color:var(--blue);padding:6px 24px;border-radius:50px;font-size:21px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-bottom:4px;flex:0 0 auto}
.scene{width:100%;height:clamp(175px,30dvh,240px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:7px;flex:0 0 auto}
.scene img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center}
.answers{display:grid;gap:7px}
.answer{min-height:49px;border:2.5px solid var(--blue3);border-radius:17px;background:#fff;padding:7px 14px;text-align:left;color:var(--blue);font-size:18px;font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;cursor:pointer}
.answer.correct{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--greenbg)}
.answer.wrong{border-color:var(--red);background:var(--redbg);color:#b23737}
.mark{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-size:21px;font-weight:900;flex:0 0 auto}
.writebox{display:grid;gap:7px}
.promptline{min-height:49px;border:2.5px solid var(--blue3);border-radius:17px;padding:7px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:18px;font-weight:900}
.promptline.good{border-color:var(--green);background:var(--greenbg)}
.promptline.bad{border-color:var(--red);background:var(--redbg)}
.promptline input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:none;background:transparent;border-bottom:2px solid #95bff0;padding:2px 1px;font:inherit;color:var(--blue)}
.bottom{margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid #8cb5ea;padding-top:4px;color:var(--blue);font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.finish{display:none;flex:1;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
.finish.show{display:flex}
.finish .starbig{font-size:56px}
.finish h2{margin:5px 0;color:var(--blue);font-size:30px}
.finish p{margin:0;color:#5371a0;font-size:16px}

@media (max-height:720px) {
  .app{padding-top:4px}
  h1{font-size:29px}
  .subtitle{font-size:17px}
  .score{font-size:14px}
  .star{font-size:22px}
  .pill{height:39px;font-size:14px;padding:0 12px}
  .icon-ball{width:27px;height:27px;font-size:18px}
  .verb{font-size:18px;padding:5px 18px}
  .scene{height:clamp(150px,26dvh,190px);margin-bottom:5px}
  .answer,.promptline{min-height:43px;font-size:16px}
  .bottom{font-size:12px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
  <main id="game">
    <div class="header">
      <div class="tools">
        <button class="toolbtn" id="soundBtn" type="button" aria-label="Heli välja" title="Heli">🔊</button>
        <button class="toolbtn" id="shareBtn" type="button" aria-label="Jaga mängu" title="Jaga">↗</button>
      </div>
      <h1>TEGUSÕNAD</h1>
      <div class="subtitle" id="subtitle">Vali õige vorm</div>
      <div class="score">
        <div class="stars" id="stars"></div>
        <span id="counter">0 / 10</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="pills">
      <div class="pill person-pill"><span class="icon-ball">👧</span><span id="person">TEMA</span></div>
      <div class="pill time-pill"><span class="icon-ball">☀️</span><span>PRAEGU</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="verb" id="verb">JOOMA</div>
    <div class="scene"><img id="sceneImg" alt=""></div>
    <div id="answerArea"></div>
    <div id="live" aria-live="polite" style="position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap"></div>
    <div class="bottom">edukass.ee</div>
  </main>

  <section class="finish" id="finish">
    <div class="starbig">🌟</div>
    <h2>Valmis!</h2>
    <p>Kõik 35 ülesannet on tehtud.</p>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
const IMG = {
  KIRJUTAMA_SINGLE: "data:image/webp;base64,
